versions.name: Kia Kima Scout Reservation

features.note: John A. Cooper Lake at Camp Cherokee and the South Fork River below Camp Osage.
Camp Osage serves meals in a dining hall.
Troops in Camp Cherokee cook in their own sites from commissary-issued food.

versions.summary: Chickasaw Council resident camp spanning roughly 540 acres in the Arkansas Ozarks along the South Fork River. Offerings include scoutcraft, aquatics, shooting sports, climbing/COPE, the Trailblazers first-year program, and Ozark Venture high adventure, with dining hall and troop cooking options.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
